candleglass.name: Candleglass
candleglass.desc: A shard of window fused with votive wax. In ruin the glass weeps out of the frames; in glory it never fell. Hold it to the light and a saint's sleeve is still in it.

sun_creed_charm.name: Sun-Creed Charm
sun_creed_charm.desc: A pilgrim's token: the sun half-sunk behind the Black Gate. The creed ran 'wake, watch, wait'. Three words for a kingdom that managed two of them.

tallow_heart.name: Tallow Heart
tallow_heart.desc: Rendered from a saint's own votive. It does not beat; it keeps.
